new: The ER calculator counts every energy weapon from its game text (Lumidouce Elegy, Dialogues of the Desert Sages, Tome of the Eternal Flow, Frostbreath and more), each at most once per its cooldown.
The ER calculator counts The Exile's 4-piece: 6 Energy to each other member per Burst of the wearer.
The rotation writer shows the time per rotation as Team Optimize and KQM count it, and when a rotation has to wait for a cooldown, how long it takes without waiting and what it waits for.
The KQM tab's timeline shows the weapon and set buffs of the builds shown, each named by its weapon or set.
The timeline fits a phone in landscape: the detailed view opens full screen and the writer is one column.
The weapon chooser in Team optimize has a None button: untick everything, then tick just the weapons you want.
fixed: Heart of the Furnace's 4-piece now needs the wearer's own Stellar Glimmer hits or reactions and lasts 12 s; it was counted all rotation whenever anyone in the team made Stellar reactions.
Instructor's 4-piece now needs the wearer to trigger the reaction while on the field.
Shimenawa's Reminiscence lasts 10 s after the wearer's Skill on the field; it was counted all rotation.
Gilded Dreams' 4-piece now counts in KQM, for 8 s after the wearer's own reactions (once every 8 s); KQM always had it off.
Disenchantment in Deep Shadow's CRIT Rate now counts while Superconduct or the Polestar field is on the enemy; it never counted.
Finale of the Deep Galleries counts only for characters without Energy (Skirk, Mavuika), and its two halves lock each other out for 6 s; it was counted for everyone.
Scroll of the Hero of Cinder City: Spread counts as Dendro only, and Hyperbloom and Burgeon now trigger it.
A Day Carved From Rising Winds needs the wearer's own Normal, Charged, Skill or Burst hits and lasts 6 s; it was on for everyone.
Crimson Witch of Flames: each Skill refreshes all its stacks, as in the game.
Deepwood Memories is triggered by the wearer's Skill and Burst hits of any element, not by Dendro hits.
Nymph's Dream counts one stack per kind of attack the wearer landed on the field in the last 8 s; it was counted at 3 stacks.
Long Night's Oath stacks come from the wearer's Plunging, Charged and Skill hits on the field, 6 s each, up to 5.
Legacy of the First Chronicle gives one Starspark per Normal Attack; it was counted twice.
Martial Artist lasts 8 s after the Skill and Maiden Beloved 10 s after the Skill or Burst; they were counted all rotation.
Lavawalker, Thundersoother and Blizzard Strayer count hit by hit from the enemy's element at that hit, KQM's candidate sets too.
A set's switch turned on by hand no longer keeps its effect on all rotation when the rotation never triggers it (for example, Viridescent Venerer's shred of an element nobody swirls).

Without a written rotation: Aubade of Morningstar and Moon counts for members that make no Normal or Charged Attacks, Husk of Opulent Dreams only for Geo characters, and Berserker, Brave Heart and Tiny Miracle are off.
Team Optimize counts a rotation's real pace: a rotation that uses a skill faster than its cooldown allows was counted at its first, fastest time.
KQM: a character you set to use their Burst every 2nd or 3rd rotation in the ER calculator now does so in the played rotation, instead of waiting for it every time.
The rotation text now understands character names in your language (Russian, Chinese and so on), and a rotation written without arrows between characters is read correctly.
The timeline no longer disappears behind the hit cards on a laptop screen at 100% zoom.

new: Your data now live in the browser's database (IndexedDB) instead of local storage, so the 5 MB storage limit is gone. Everything moves over by itself on your first visit, and every entry is checked before the old copy is removed.
Saving happens in the background and no longer stalls the page. If a save ever fails, a notice says so and leaving the page asks first.
Saved KQM results take about a fifth of the space they did.
The rotation writer's hit cards show each attack in its own colour, as the rotation panel does.
fixed: Sandrone's Stellar-Swirl charged beam used the Stellar-Conduct multiplier; it now uses its own, higher one.
Exaiphanes Blade's ATK bonus at R4 and R5 is 32% and 40%, as in the game.
DEF reduction is capped at 90%, as in the game.
Team buffs from elemental resonance and reactions say so in their tooltip, instead of naming the active character.
Theorycraft: when no substat distribution meets your stat filters, your substats are kept and a warning says so; they used to be overwritten.
Optimize: a target that adds up to nothing (for example, its talent conditional is off) can't be started, and the button's tooltip says why.
Team import: errors show in the import dialog, and pasting a character's multi-target setup tells you where to import it.

new: Rotation writer: point at any moment of the timeline to read it (who is on the field, the enemy's aura, stacks, the hit there and its damage), and click to pin it. "Detailed timeline" opens a large window with the enemy's aura, every stack and resource over time, each member's buffs, the damage as it adds up, and a card for each member showing their stats, stacks and buffs at that moment.
The Teams page is redesigned: each member is a game-style card with their weapon, artifact sets and main stats, hover any of them for details, and every team shows its elemental resonance.

KQM Theorycrafting: Instructor and The Exile can be chosen, counted by KQM Standards for 4★ artifacts (lower main stats, 0.8 of the substats and 2 fewer distributed rolls for each 4★ piece, one 5★ off-piece).
KQM Theorycrafting: each weapon group's refinement (R1 to R5) is chosen right in the setup.
improved: Rotation writer: each member's hits are cards with every attack's share, and the notes fold behind one line.
fixed: KQM Theorycrafting: the rotation preview and timeline on the KQM tab play at the constellations set in KQM Setup, not your own.
Heretic's Molten Blade counts only after its wielder's Elemental Skill while they are on the field, not for every hit.

new: KQM Theorycrafting: the attacks of the rotation played for the builds open to show each buff up during the attack, what it gives and how much it adds, and the hit's stats, all for the builds shown. Picking other equipment in the results updates the rotation's attacks and damage.
fixed: Moonpiercer's ATK counts only when its wielder triggers Dendro reactions itself, as for Sapwood Blade and Forest Regalia, so it no longer ranks first in teams without Dendro.

KQM Theorycrafting: a weapon that changes a teammate's Energy Recharge requirement (Favonius) is scored with that teammate's artifacts built again, so the Energy Recharge it frees turns into damage, and picking another weapon never leaves a teammate short of its Energy Recharge.
KQM Theorycrafting: an attack opened before a run, or with an older run, no longer shows its buffs loading forever.

improved: KQM Theorycrafting: the setup has a Weapons and artifact sets section. Battle Pass, 4★ event wish, 5★ standard wish and 5★ event wish weapons switch on and off right there, each showing the refinement it counts at; Choose weapons and Choose sets pick them one by one.
fixed: The Widsith counts the average of its three songs, for 10 s each time its wielder takes the field (once per 30 s), instead of always its ATK song. Its passive also has an "Average of the three" option.

Rotation writer: tapping Mitya's Skill again to switch his Detection Core between modes no longer detonates his Gradient Beacons, so his next Charged Attack in Overload is a Gradient Detonation that spends them. As in game, only a Steady core detonates them: when it ends, or when his Skill is tapped or held anew after its cooldown.

new: KQM Theorycrafting: Top teams, under the member inspector: the best team, then the best teams that change one member's weapon or artifact sets, each with its team DPS and how far it is from the best. The member that changes stands out; pick a team to see it. The top 50 open in a window.

Rotation writer: a wait while Mualani surfs in Nightsoul's Blessing builds Wave Momentum, as walking does in game, so "E W90f N1" plays a Surging Bite. Waits can now be written in frames: W90f is 90 frames.
KQM Theorycrafting: member cards show the weapon and artifact sets of each build, and the constellation as a badge.
improved: KQM Theorycrafting generates builds about 4 times faster, with the same results.
fixed: KQM Theorycrafting now counts what a set or weapon does in the rotation before it is picked, so sets like Viridescent Venerer are chosen when their effect helps the team (Stellar Swirl teams no longer stay on Blizzard Strayer).
KQM Theorycrafting: picking another weapon or set in a result plays the rotation again with it, so the buffs and debuffs it gives the team are counted.
KQM Theorycrafting gives a weapon the game has one copy of (Exaiphanes' Blade and other quest rewards) to one member at most.
Rotation writer: Mualani's surfing jumps, dashes and bites no longer delay her next Skill, so every rotation plays its Surging Bites.
Epochal Advent's 4-piece bonus counts while the wearer is off the field again.

new: KQM Theorycrafting: picking another weapon or set now updates the team DPS and every member card, and picks for several members add up.
KQM Theorycrafting: each member card shows how many rolls went to each substat (hover for fixed, added and total); the same line sits next to Artifact totals.
Rotation timeline: each swap now shows as its own block before the next member's actions.

Frame data: actions that change in a mode or stance (Zibai's Spirit Steed's Stride, Wanderer's Windfavored attacks, Raiden's Musou Isshin and more) have their own rows, so editing one no longer changes the other.

KQM Theorycrafting (Beta): a new tab on every team. It builds each member from KQM-standard artifacts and the weapons you allow, for the team's rotation, and ranks the sets and weapons for each member. Runs keep going in the background, and the last result is still there after a reload.
Team Optimize: write a rotation as text, like “Odette EE -> Mitya E -> Sandrone Q”. It is played out with each character's frame data: cooldowns, energy, reactions and when buffs are up.
Team Optimize has a cleaner look, with details in tooltips, and “What raises team damage” now stays with the saved result.
fixed: Every character released or buffed since 5.0 now follows the game text at every constellation.
Many older characters' buffs and constellations now follow the game text too.

new: Team Optimize: exclude artifacts from a team's optimization. Press ⊘ on an artifact in a result, or find artifacts by set, slot and main stat under Optimize team → Excluded artifacts, where each can be used again.

fixed: Optimize and Team Optimize keep running at full speed when the tab is in the background or the window is minimised.
Anastasya: her C2 and C6 bonuses now show their Stellar Swirl lines too (the damage already counted them).

improved: Danica and the Tsaritsa follow the latest beta data: the Tsaritsa's Palestar Crown and her burst's Stellar Glimmer bonus are lower.
The upcoming artifact sets have their official names, Epochal Advent and Empyrean Sojourn.
fixed: Epochal Advent's 4-piece bonus only counts while the wearer is on the field, as in the latest beta.

title: Build cards
new: Build card: a picture of a character's build to download or copy, from the character page or a team member's page. It shows the character's art, constellation, talents, weapon, artifacts with their Roll Value and Crit Value, the artifacts' totals and the character's own stats.
Choose which substats count toward a character's Roll Value on its build card; the others are dimmed.
Team card in Team Optimize results: the team's DPS and rotation, then every member's build card with its share of the damage, in one picture.

title: The first Stellar Optimizer release
new: Team Optimize: optimize the whole team's artifacts and weapons for one rotation, with energy weapons, member swaps, the closest build when a requirement can't be met, and the next best team builds.
Improve tab (formerly the Artifact Upgrader), with a built-in substat value and a what-to-farm strip.
One-click theorycraft of any build, with its best roll distribution.
Mitya and Valeriy, with their weapons, from beta data ahead of their release.
The unreleased characters Danica and Anastasya, with the upcoming weapons and artifact sets.
A best-build page for every character, and an FAQ.
This changelog, links to the source on GitHub and a Buy me a coffee link.
improved: A much faster artifact optimizer: a new search engine, sped up with WebGPU where the browser supports it.
A new look: dark theme, compact navigation, a home dashboard, and redesigned Optimize tab, filters and character cards.
Pages answer clicks at once, art loads as WebP, and the site always runs its latest version.
Official Chinese terms, and stat names that can be translated.
No ads; privacy-friendly analytics without cookies.
fixed: Team Optimize keeps each member to its allowed sets: a member takes the pieces its sets need from a teammate, or the run tells you who can't fit.
Team Optimize no longer keeps a weapon left out of "Weapons to choose from" when a ticked one was free.
